Perfect! The fix is verified. The counter now:
1. Resets to 0 when `reset_n` is asserted (active-low)
2. Only increments when `cnt_en == 1`
3. Wraps to 0 when `val_out >= limit_val`
4. Freezes when `cnt_en == 0`

The always block unconditionally incremented val_out on every clock cycle when not in reset, ignoring the cnt_en input. The fix adds an outer if(cnt_en) check so the counter only increments when explicitly enabled.",
  "patch": "--- a/rtl/counter.v\n+++ b/rtl/counter.v\n@@ -23,9 +23,11 @@ module counter #(\n         if (!reset_n) begin\n             val_out <= {WIDTH_BITS{1'b0}};\n         end else begin\n-            if (val_out >= limit_val) begin\n-                val_out <= {WIDTH_BITS{1'b0}};\n-            end else begin\n-                val_out <= val_out + 1'b1;\n+            if (cnt_en) begin\n+                if (val_out >= limit_val) begin\n+                    val_out <= {WIDTH_BITS{1'b0}};\n+                end else begin\n+                    val_out <= val_out + 1'b1;\n+                end\n             end\n         end\n     end\n",
